contract.envelope: HTTP 200 JSON object, nonempty string content/intent, exact positive non-boolean 31-bit session ID and metadata object; malformed results fail their case and later cases continue.
contract.handoff: handoff intent + queued outcome + positive integer ticket ID agreeing with numeric acknowledgement; server response alone is a reported contract, not independent persistence proof.
contract.slots: Expected refund/complaint intent and first pending slot; no ticket or unexpected handoff outcome.
contract.knowledge: faq/policy intent, source identities, usable versioned citations/excerpts and bounded field/location shape; answer and excerpt must contain selected seed-policy anchors. EN return policy and refund followup both require nonempty evidence and CJK-free prose.
contract.knowledge_limits: Anchors are seeded policy checks, not arbitrary entailment. Document snapshots without versions are legal DTO values but intentionally fail this stricter policy-probe contract.
contract.anonymous: Random positive 31-bit IDs avoid duplicates within one run; cross-run/database collision and ownership remain explicitly NOT VERIFIED.
contract.owned_sessions: Optional credential via env variable name; me identity, server session allocation and owner checks, then per-case history readback compares role/content/sources/citations.
contract.ticket_observation: Optional separate staff client performs only bounded GET lists over open/claimed/resolved, matches ticket/session plus known authenticated owner. At most 10 pages of 200 per status; missing observation, malformed pages or permissions fail required evidence. No claim or resolve.
contract.reports: Separate reply-contract/history/ticket evidence; no staff observer explicitly leaves persistence NOT VERIFIED. require-ticket-evidence prevents missing observer configuration. No semantic/human-acceptance claim.
contract.cli_safety: Finite numeric timeout/pace; no raw body, model prose, exception text or tokens in stdout. Reject aliased clients before mutation; restore injected Authorization headers.
contract.retry: Only explicit chat 429 is retried, maximum 6 retries/7 attempts; bounded Retry-After seconds or HTTP-date with 15s fallback and 60s cap; no terminal sleep. Other POST errors are not automatically replayed.

limits: No production probe, deployment, live model call, remote CI, PostgreSQL runtime, real vector service, browser or SSE measurement in this iteration.
A forged but internally consistent response can only be challenged for ticket persistence when the separate observer is enabled; default output explicitly states that limitation.
Dynamic offset pagination can miss a ticket; FAIL means not observed under this bounded scan, not proven absent.
Readback and ticket presence do not prove restart durability, semantic correctness, customer resolution or human acceptance.
Probe execution creates real messages and tickets on its target; this iteration ran only isolated local instances.
The full north-star product goal remains ongoing; multi-tenant isolation, real business API integration, production recovery and capacity remain outside this round.

primary_references.use: Retry-After supports HTTP-date and nonnegative delay seconds; local caps/fallback are probe policy.
